title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $200 on the Eufy Omni S2
excerpt: Get vacuuming and mopping help with this powerful combo cleaner.
content_html:
SAVE $200: As of Aug. 14, the Eufy Omni S2 robot vacuum and mop has been discounted to $1,399.99 at Amazon. That's $200 off its full price of $1,599.99.

Credit: Eufy

$1,399.99 at Amazon
$1,599.99 Save $200

Keeping your house clean, especially if you have a busy summer schedule, can feel like a lot. That's where robot vacuums come in handy. While the FCC may have banned models made outside the U.S., you can still get models already in circulation, and Amazon's a great spot to find deals.

If you're looking for a robot vacuum that can also mop, the Eufy Omni S2 is one option on sale right now.

As of Aug. 14, Amazon has the Eufy Omni S2 robot vacuum and mop discounted to $1,399.99 for a limited time. Compared to its full price of $1,599.99, that's $200 in savings.

Mashable Trend Report

With such a premium price tag, the Eufy Omni S2 offers quite a lot when it comes to cleaning. In terms of vacuuming, it features AeroTurbo 2.0 technology and 30,000 Pa of suction with 100 AW airflow, which can clean deep into carpets. It also comes with a DuoSpiral main brush and anti-tangle side brushes that help prevent hair of all lengths from getting caught up inside it and slowing it down.

Mopping is mighty helpful as well. This combo cleaner can generate electrolyzed water on every pass, which helps kill off bacteria. Its HydroJet 2.0 technology uses 140-degree Fahrenheit water to clean the roller mop as well, so every clean feels fresh. Not to mention, it can easily detect floor types as it's moving around, so the mop will auto-lift if it hits a carpet.

Plus, the Eufy Omni S2 features 3D MatrixEye 2.0 smart navigation technology to help avoid obstacles and get an efficient clean in every room. If it sounds like the perfect fit for you, don't miss out on this great deal at Amazon.

保持房子清洁，尤其是如果你的夏季日程很繁忙，可能会让人感觉很重要。 这就是扫地机器人派上用场的地方。 虽然美国联邦通信委员会可能禁止在美国境外制造的型号，但您仍然可以获得已经流通的型号，而亚马逊是寻找优惠的好地方。

如果您正在寻找一款兼具拖地功能的扫地机器人，Eufy Omni S2 是目前在售的一个选择。

截至 8 月 14 日，亚马逊 Eufy Omni S2 扫地机器人和拖把限时折扣至 1,399.99 美元。 与全价 1,599.99 美元相比，节省了 200 美元。

可混搭趋势报告

凭借如此高的价格标签，Eufy Omni S2 在清洁方面提供了相当多的功能。 吸尘方面，它采用AeroTurbo 2.0技术，30,000Pa的吸力和100AW的气流，可​​以深入清洁地毯。 它还配备了 DuoSpiral 主刷和防缠结侧刷，有助于防止各种长度的头发被卷入其中并减慢速度。

拖地也很有帮助。 这款组合清洁剂每次通过时都会产生电解水，有助于杀死细菌。 其 HydroJet 2.0 技术也使用 140 华氏度的水来清洁滚筒拖把，因此每次清洁都感觉清新。 更不用说，它可以在移动时轻松检测地板类型，因此如果拖把碰到地毯，它会自动升起。

此外，Eufy Omni S2 采用 3D MatrixEye 2.0 智能导航技术，有助于避开障碍物并在每个房间进行高效清洁。 如果这听起来非常适合您，请不要错过亚马逊的这项超值优惠。
